optimizedDescription.value: specd.yaml authoritatively configures schema, workspaces, storage, plugins, context, approvals, and layered overrides.

optimizedContext.value:
# Config

## Rules
- Discovery: `--config` = explicit file + own `extends`; else walk CWD→VCS root, stop first dir with candidates; no VCS → CWD only. Candidates order: `specd.yaml`, `specd.*.yaml` alpha, `specd.local.yaml`, `specd.local.*.yaml` alpha.
- `extends: true` inherits prior active layer; `extends: <path>` activates only when base already chain. Never above VCS root. Bootstrap API may supply discovery root; command-specific unconfigured bootstrap allowed.
- Cascade: scalars last-wins; objects deep-merge; arrays append unless `remove`. `remove` only with `extends`; required `schema` non-removable. Identities: `context[].id`, `plugins.agents[].name`, workspace/storage keys. `specd init` gitignores local variants.
- `privacy`: `mode` `hash|mask|anonymous`; optional `salt`, `excludeActors` default `"specd", "system@getspecd.dev"`, `allowedMetadataKeys`. Env wins: `SPECD_ACTOR_PROVIDER`, `SPECD_PRIVACY_SALT`, `SPECD_PRIVACY_MODE` (+ `.env`/`.env.local`). `actorProvider` forces registry provider.
- Required `schema` refs: `@pkg`, `#ws:name`, `#name`/bare (default), path. Resolve at dispatch; skip help/version/init/config validate/plugin. Distinct `ConfigValidationError`, `SchemaNotFoundError`, `SchemaValidationError`.
- Optional `invalidationPolicy`: `none|surgical|downstream|global` default for new changes.
- Workspaces: mandatory `default`; names `/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/`; `specs` always; non-default `codeRoot` required; `schemas`, `ownership` default `owned`, `prefix`, context patterns, graph filters. `isExternal` inferred.
- Workspace `graph`: `allowedPaths`, `respectGitignore` default `true`/absolute priority, `excludePaths` replaces builtins when set. Project `graph.includePaths`/`excludePaths`; include path maps `root:` unless inside owned `codeRoot`.
- Optional named `storage` adapters changes/drafts/discarded/archive; omit = fs defaults under `specdPath`. `specdPath` default `.specd`; derives graph/tmp/change-locks; missing dirs → `StorageDirectoryNotFoundError`.
- Preserve unresolved `{{namespace.key}}` + warning. `schemaPlugins` same refs, `kind: schema-plugin`; apply `schemaOverrides` (`SchemaOperations`) after plugins.
- Context: project + workspace patterns; active workspace has change specs. Order project entries → project include/exclude → active ws include/exclude → `dependsOn`; exclusions never dependencies. Defaults project `default:*`, ws `*`. Unknown qualifier warns runtime, errors `config validate`.
- `contextMode`: `list|summary` default|`full|hybrid`; project-only; no legacy `lazy`. `context[]`: instruction or file, optional `id`.
- `approvals.spec`/`approvals.signoff` default false. `logging.level` default `info`; `llmOptimizedContext` default false. `plugins.agents[]` Zod-validated; `ConfigWriter`: `initProject`, `addPlugin`, `removePlugin`, `listPlugins`. Legacy shape yields non-fatal `SpecdConfig.warnings`.

## Constraints
- Zod validate every field at load; strict unknown top-level rejection.
- `privacy.mode=hash` requires config/env salt.
- Cascade failures throw `ConfigValidationError`.
